description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Vizier of Tumbling Sands to gain all creature types.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion
